description: Spread a prepaid expense (insurance, software subscription, rent paid ahead, maintenance contract) over the months it covers. Send the amount, the first day covered and either the number of months or the last day covered, and the method: monthly (an equal share per month, the default) or daily (each month's share in proportion to the days it covers). Get back the expense for every month, the amount expensed to date and the prepaid balance left at each month end, and, if you send as_of_month, the figures for that month end. Rounding is carried forward so the months add up to the amount to the cent. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/prepaid-amortization). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

amount.description: Amount paid in advance (the prepaid asset at the start).

as_of_month.description: Optional month end to report, YYYY-MM: expense in that month, expensed to date and the balance left.

end_date.description: Last day covered, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (2026-12-31 for a policy from 2026-01-01). Send months or end_date, not both.

label.description: Optional label (your own text, echoed back; not a person).

method.description: monthly (default): an equal share each month, starting in the month of start_date; daily: each calendar month's share = its covered days / all covered days.

months.description: Length of cover in months (12 for a one-year policy). Send months or end_date, not both.

start_date.description: First day the payment covers, YYYY-MM-DD.
